name: acid
title: ACID 3 synth engine (TD-3-MO-style bassline: 303 type with the modded-out mods)
summary: Pick ACID 3 in the engine list or the 'acid 3' preset: a monophonic bassline voice in the style of the Behringer TD-3-MO, its sound a fixed-point port of Open303 (MIT, NOTICE: TB-303 diode-ladder filter model, measured cutoff / env-mod mapping, envelopes, accent, slide; A/B within 0.2 dB / 0.03 oct of Open303): saw / square + sub oscillator, overdrive into a resonant 4-pole filter (303 type: feedback high-pass, tanh-limited), the envelope with normal and accent decay, accent with its sweep circuit (OFF / NORM / HIGH, SLOW / NORM / FAST), slide (10 .. 360 ms, legato keys or every note), soft attack, filter tracking, filter FM, muffler. Accents from MIDI velocity, every note or every 2nd / 3rd / 4th note. Page 1 (cutoff, resonance, env mod, decay) can be moved by TE's LFO. Shift + blue turn browses P-- and 16 built-in sounds; page 6 = the sound's FX knobs. The screen is a green (80s phosphor) LCD 16x2 (the knob turned last, the page, the note) over 16 step lamps (the last notes: accents, slides), above the page's knobs as the other engines. Presets stay drwave presets with in-range values.
controls: engine list: ACID 3; preset browser: folder acid 3 (one preset, 'acid 3'); sounds: shift + blue turn (P-- + 16)

ACID 3 sound: knob push cycles page 1 FILTER (CUTOFF RESONANCE ENV MOD DECAY) / 2 ACCENT (ACCENT ACC DECAY SWEEP SPEED) / 3 VCO (WAVE SUB TUNE SLIDE) / 4 MODS (SOFT ATK TRACKING FILTER FM OVERDRIVE) / 5 PLAY (MUFFLER ACCENTS SLIDES LEVEL) / 6 FX knobs
slide: a note played while another key is held (SLIDES LEGATO); accents: ACCENTS ALL / VEL (MIDI) / 2ND / 3RD / 4TH
